import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[n+' input']; go=G[n+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); A,B=len(go),len(go[0])
    tw=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    arm=[(r,c) for r in range(A) for c in range(B) if go[r][c]==2]
    ps=sorted({c-r for r in range(A) for c in range(B) if go[r][c]==1})
    bs=sorted(set(c-r for r,c in tw))
    print('===',n,'arm:',arm[:6],'seed offsets:',bs,'painted:',ps)

    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G
